channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Age of Wonders 4: Rise from Ruin
item.description: Forge a mighty realm from the ashes in Age of Wonders 4: Rise from Ruin. Contains a new culture, form, wildlife and magical tomes, as well as new environmental challenges and locations to conquer and explore.

item.title: Age of Wonders 4: Thrones of Blood
item.description: Embrace the night in Age of Wonders 4: Thrones of Blood! Command vampire legions, build your dark empire with blood magic, and dominate sunless lands. Features a new vampire ruler, tomes, wildlife, and a story realm exploring Elder Vampire origins.

item.title: Astra Bestiary
item.description: Raise Beasts from eggs into powerful Champions in this 2D monster-raising/taming RPG. Feed, train and evolve your partners to explore a perilous, non-linear world. Master fast-paced, tactical battles, uncover the secrets of a fading world and pass on the Beasts' legacy across generations.

item.title: Atelier Marie Remake: The Alchemist of Salburg
item.description: It's not about saving the world. In this "leisure adventure RPG," failing student Marie pursues alchemy, adventures, and quests while aiming to graduate in five years. "Atelier Marie," the origin of the Atelier series, has been remade with new elements!

item.title: CONTROL Resonant
item.description: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and our survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

item.title: CONTROL Resonant Digital Deluxe Upgrade
item.description: Go behind the scenes of CONTROL Resonant with the Digital Artbook, immerse yourself in new music from the Original Soundtrack, and enhance your experience with a unique AWE Mission Outfit, Untapped Artifact (Wallet), and Starter Resource Bundle.

item.title: Dead Sector
item.description: Run your own data center. Design server boards component by component and use your boards space wisely. Wire power and network throughout your floor to form specialized clusters, and dispatch contracts to your custom hardware. Scale from a single rack to a massive redundant, multi-cluster operation.

item.title: Dungeon Rampage Remastered
item.description: Battle your way to victory in this 1-4 player co-op hack-n-slash dungeon crawler completely remastered! Play as a dynamic cast of heroes slicing their way through dungeons, earning weapons and loot. Rampage past a gauntlet of enemies and destruction to end the evil Lord Dinglepus' reign!

item.title: Dungeons & Dynasties
item.description: DnD meets Football Manager. Create a guild, watch them form relationships and grow old together. Lose people both to the dark and to rival guilds battling to be the best in the realm. Grow your own town, or vote to help build an existing one. Or take the Cozy approach and run a guild on your terms.

item.title: DYNASTY WARRIORS 8 Empires
item.description: DYNASTY WARRIORS 8 Empires is part of the "Empires" series, in which you aim to conquer ancient China using both strategy and the one warrior versus one thousand tactical action the WARRIORS series is known for.

item.title: Hypnospace Outlaw
item.description: Greetings Enforcer, and thank you for enlisting in the Hypnospace Patrol Department! As the world falls into its slumber, Hypnospace becomes a bustling global village. These virtual streets aren't going to police themselves!

item.title: Little Rocket Lab
item.description: Transform your childhood home as you build brilliant factories and forge lifelong friendships, then reach for the skies and finally finish your family's dream - your mother's precious rocket ship. Roll up your sleeves, it turns out that saving this town really IS rocket science!

item.title: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator
item.description: Run your own ice cream shop in a vibrant Caribbean setting! Prepare ice cream, mix flavors, add toppings, serve customers, keep your shop clean, restock ingredients, hire staff, and expand your shop from a small stand into a busy business.

item.title: Loftia
item.description: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

item.title: Mycelarium
item.description: Grow an ever-expanding fungal network in this relaxing incremental exploration game. Discover hidden resources, cultivate mushrooms that automate your production, and evolve your mycelium into a self-sustaining underground empire.

item.title: Potato Please
item.description: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

item.title: Project Afterfall
item.description: Wake to a brutal world of Thea, bent on destroying your colony. Rebuild, Explore the Wastelands, and Gather scarce resources. Will you strike a deal with the ruthless Baba Yaga - or hack a rogue Cyber-Rat to turn it into an ally? A dark strategy-survival RPG with card-based tactical combat.

item.title: Ramen Shop Simulator
item.description: Take control of your very own Ramen Shop! Transform a cozy, worn-out Japanese alley back into a vibrant hotspot. From scrubbing floors to cooking the perfect bowl of ramen. Decorate every corner, upgrade everything, and create your unique shop.

item.title: Scam Line
item.description: Scam Line is a 4–8 player social deception game where your party will face different challenges. Become a liar, a manipulator, a cheater, or find your own path to victory

item.title: Traffic Architect
item.description: Become the master of traffic with your expert infrastructure designs. Lay down streets, shape junctions, time traffic lights, design a public transport network, and watch the city come alive. It grows on its own, and every new building sends more trips onto the roads you built.

item.title: Beat For Speed
item.description: Turn any song into a playable rhythm ride! Import your favorite music or play along with your device's audio in Live Audio Mode. Discover official tracks from indie artists, climb the leaderboards, create custom levels in the Level Editor, and explore endless community levels on Steam Workshop.

item.title: BOB LOGISTICS
item.description: Welcome to Bob Company! Fill orders, haul goods, and make work easier with automation. Rise from Intern to Director in a relaxing first-person warehouse sim. Each promotion opens new areas of the company and reveals more of the stories behind it.

item.title: Chicory: A Colorful Tale
item.description: A top-down adventure game in a coloring book world full of vibrant characters. Use painting powers to explore, solve puzzles, make friends, and draw on anything! From creators on Wandersong + Celeste.

item.title: Creatures of Ava
item.description: Let your empathy guide you as you play an exciting action-adventure, creature-saver game. Understand and tame the creatures of Ava and let them lead you through a variety of ecosystems – all in the hopes of saving the planet from a life-consuming infection.

item.title: Death at Fleming Manor
item.description: "Your job is to write the death certificate." Investigate a mysterious death in a British manor in 1959. Explore eerie scenes, analyze evidence, and complete death certificates and emergency reports. A forensic mystery with art inspired by 1960s European detective comics.

item.title: The Alters: Last Variable
item.description: Continue Jan Scientist's story as he stays behind to unlock the planet's secrets. Build an underground base, assemble a crew of specialised Scientist alters, master Terraformation, invent new technologies, and conduct research that could define a legacy.

item.title: The Drifter
item.description: A Pulp Adventure Thriller - A murdered drifter awakens. Alive again, seconds before his death. Hunted and haunted, help him untangle a mad web of conspiracy in this fast-paced point 'n click thrill-ride.

item.title: Wilmot Works It Out
item.description: Wilmot Works It Out is a puzzle building game about completing beautiful images and using them to decorate the walls of your house.

item.title: BOOST VECTOR EX
item.description: RUN FAST. Faster than any other. Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour racing. Hone your style with responsive, flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. The race, your friends, and victory beckon your arrival... Did I mention it was fast?

item.title: Borderlands 2 Season Pass
item.description: Grab the Borderlands 2 Season Pass and get access to four downloadable content packs for Borderlands 2 at one discounted price.

item.title: Borderlands 2: Commander Lilith & the Fight for Sanctuary
item.description: Return to the award-winning shooter-looter for an all-new adventure that sets the stage for the upcoming Borderlands 3.

item.title: Borderlands 3: Season Pass
item.description: Continue your Borderlands 3 adventure with the Season Pass, featuring exclusive cosmetic items and four story campaign add-ons with new missions and challenges!

item.title: Borderlands 3: Season Pass 2
item.description: Enhance Borderlands 3 with the content add-ons of Season Pass 2, featuring new modes and missions, a 4th skill tree for each Vault Hunter, and unique cosmetic outfits!

item.title: Borderlands Game of the Year Enhanced
item.description: Discover the original co-op shooter-looter, crammed with new enhancements! As one of 4 trigger-happy mercenaries with RPG progression, equip bazillions of guns to take on the desert planet Pandora.

item.title: Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel Season Pass
item.description: Extend the lunar mayhem with the Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel Season Pass featuring new characters, challenges, missions, and more! Harness the power of your good looks with the “Handsome Jack” Character Pack; raise your level cap & battle waves of enemies in The Holodome Onslaught; and two more add-on Packs!

item.title: Feed The Forest
item.description: Use snail powers to grow a desert into a lush forest, and then profit-maximize it to insanity in this active incremental game. Optimize plant layouts to automate production of multiple resources. Hire minions, unlock immoral plants, get ungodly rich, and remember: Blood is a type of juice.

item.title: Figure Me Out
item.description: A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.

item.title: GRAVHOUNDS
item.description: GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

item.title: Imperium
item.description: Imperium is a single-player 4X space strategy game. Colonize alien worlds, design your own spaceships, research exotic technologies, and outmaneuver rival empires through diplomacy or open war. Build a galactic empire and rule it your way.

item.title: Incremental Traffic
item.description: An incremental logistics game where traffic becomes a challenge. Haul goods from fields, forests and quarries through a procedurally generated town, earn money with every delivery and buy more trucks, until your own fleet jams the streets. Then fix it with traffic rules.

item.title: Mayday: The Survival Island
item.description: After a mysterious crash, you awaken alone on a strange island. Survive by hunting, farming, and crafting, then explore a vast archipelago filled with secrets, ancient ruins, and magical totems. Build your base, uncover the truth, and escape—if you can.

item.title: New Tales from the Borderlands
item.description: Decide the fates of altruistic scientist Anu, her ambitious, "streetwise" brother Octavio, and the fierce, frogurt-slinging Fran. Claw and con your way through five thrilling chapters!

item.title: Night in the Woods
item.description: NIGHT IN THE WOODS is an adventure game focused on exploration, story, and character, featuring dozens of characters to meet and lots to do across a lush, vibrant world.

item.title: PlinkIdle
item.description: PlinkIdle is a retro-inspired game with an idle/incremental spin on a classic ball drop mechanic. Falling balls, rare buffs, and steady upgrades unlock colorful, cozy stages and immersive environments.

item.title: Repel The Rifts
item.description: Repel the Rifts is a roguelite tower defense game where you lead a commander through an alien world, uncovering new terrain each wave, drafting powerful upgrades, and constructing defenses to hold back the chaos.

item.title: The Miner Was Replaced
item.description: Get the mining upgrade for your drone! Program it to dig, explore, and mine underground resources. Using a simple Python-like language, automate excavation, optimize mining routes, and uncover valuable minerals hidden deep beneath the surface.

item.title: Hunting Simulator 3 - Classic American Hunter Pack
item.description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.
